title: TailTrail Host Question Flow Packet View
description: A packet view is a pointer into one anchor version, never a second version history. Per TAILTRAIL-HOST-QUESTION-FLOW-DESIGN.md's 'One version chain, not two' rule and TAILTRAIL-HOST-QUESTION-FLOW-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md's Review Resolution #1: the anchor version is the only versioned truth. This schema deliberately has no packet_version/revision counter of its own -- packet_view_id identifies the projection, anchor_version identifies the sole authority it is bound to, and invalidated views are replaced, not revised in place.

anchor_version.description: e.g. 'anchor-v3'. The packet view is materialized for exactly this anchor version; it must be invalidated and regenerated when the anchor is corrected to a later version.

superseded_by.description: packet_view_id of the replacement view materialized for the next anchor version, once one exists.

consumer_component_id.description: Must resolve against the versioned component/adapter registry (Phase 6); an unregistered consumer cannot be projected to.
